thread:
maria_gonzalez: Heads-up — MapleHealth sent back the security questionnaire. They flagged RBAC scoping, KMS key provenance, and audit-log exportability as blockers for their legal review.
samir_rao: thanks — can you drop the specific asks? i skimmed but missed details.
maria_gonzalez: short version: 1) can we provide a role mapping diagram showing least-privilege for tenant admins vs Redwood ops? 2) evidence of HSM-backed key creation or KMS envelope proof + key rotation policy 3) ability to ship audit logs to their SIEM (syslog/S3 push) with integrity proof (hash chain) and retention >= 7 years.
alex.kim: for (1) we have the RBAC matrix in internal docs but not a customer-friendly diagram. i can make one. question: do they need per-tenant service-account scoping or just org-level roles?
maria_gonzalez: they explicitly asked for per-tenant scoping and example policy for onboarding a new tenant.
samir_rao: KMS: we currently support customer-managed keys (BYOK) via envelope encryption with cloud KMS and HSM options for Private deploys. we can produce a key-provenance statement but not raw HSM logs.
ryan_support: @maria_gonzalez i can attach the standard BYOK runbook we give to enterprises. includes rotation cadence and emergency-rekey steps.
sec-bot: automated note: link to BYOK runbook created: https://internal.redwood/byok-runbook (access: eng-security, sales)
alex.kim: for log export/integrity — we have two delivery modes: (a) push to customer S3 with per-batch SHA256 manifest, (b) syslog stream to customer SIEM with TLS + seq numbers. the hash-chain proof we used for Acme was a rolling manifest signed by our KMS key.
maria_gonzalez: do we have a template manifest example we can share? they want to see fields and example verification steps.
amir_rao: (typo) samir_rao: yes — here's a tiny example we can paste:

```
{
  "batch_id": "2024-08-01T12:00:00Z-0001",
  "records": 1024,
  "sha256_root": "3b7f...e4a9",
  "prev_root": "1c2d...9f00",
  "signed_by": "redwood-kms-prod"
}
```

samir_rao: verification steps we provide in docs: pull manifest, compute sha256 over sorted records, compare root, check KMS signature via our public cert.
ryan_support: maplehealth also asked about log redaction for PHI — can we confirm redaction happens before export and that redaction rules are customer-configurable?
alex.kim: yes — redaction runs in the pipeline before export. we have a configurable filter set (regex and structured fields). need to confirm retention policies for their legal team: we can set retention on exported S3 buckets or their SIEM.
maria_gonzalez: action items: alex to produce RBAC diagram + onboarding policy example; samir to draft KMS key provenance statement + sample manifest; ryan to attach BYOK runbook and redaction FAQ. send to MapleHealth by EOD tomorrow.
samir_rao: i'll also note the incident playbook: in case of suspected key compromise we do immediate rotation, re-encrypt in-flight caches, and provide a signed timeline to customer. i'll draft that short blurb.
alex.kim: quick Q: they asked if logs include tenant_id and request_id for traceability — yes, we include both in every event (request metadata) but we can mask payloads.
maria_gonzalez: perfect. last ask: can we offer a short live walk-through call for their security team? they prefer Wed morning PST.
ryan_support: i'm available Wed 10am PST. i'll add meeting invite once docs are ready.
sec-bot: reminder: create a customer folder in drive: /secure/MapleHealth/SQ/ and place artifacts. permission: eng-security, sales, solutions.
maria_gonzalez: thanks team. i'll assemble a single PDF packet and post here when ready. ping me if you need specific phrasing for legal.
